units.source_text: 告别赛进行了一半，名人就进了圣路加医院。

en.t: Halfway through the farewell match, the Master was admitted to St. Luke's Hospital.
I once went to visit him there.

units.source_text: 这家医院的病房内，家具适合美国人的体格，都是特大号的。

en.t: In the wards of that hospital, the furniture was built for American physiques and was all extra large.

units.source_text: 名人身材短小，一坐在高高的病榻上，就有点令人担忧了。

en.t: The Master was small in build, and when he sat on the high hospital bed, he looked a little worrying.

units.source_text: 他脸上的浮肿大多消去了，双颊长了点肉，神态自若，

en.t: Most of the swelling in his face had gone down, his cheeks had filled out a little, and his manner was composed,

units.source_text: 但最难得的是他卸下了心头的沉重负担，无拘无束，

en.t: but what was rarest was that he had laid down the heavy burden on his heart and seemed free and unconstrained,

units.source_text: 这同对弈时的老人简直判若两人。

en.t: he was almost a different person from the old man during the match.
